families.name: Llama
families.scope: Llama, CodeLlama, and Llama Guard language models. Each sub-line retains its own version; parameter sizes and backbone versions are excluded.

families.name: Gemma
families.scope: Gemma and named generative relatives, including CodeGemma, RecurrentGemma, PaliGemma, ShieldGemma, DataGemma, MedGemma, TxGemma, T5Gemma, VaultGemma, FunctionGemma, TranslateGemma, and DiffusionGemma. Embedding and interpretability artifacts are watched but do not compete.

families.name: Python
families.scope: All stable Python 3 minor and patch releases from 3.0 in the official release archive. Previews are excluded.

families.name: PyTorch
families.scope: All numbered PyTorch minor and patch releases in the official GitHub release catalog, including 0.x. Drafts and entries marked prerelease are excluded.

families.name: GTA
families.scope: GTA V platform releases, rereleases, and title updates in the saved GTA Wiki version history. Every release scores 5. Weekly content events are excluded.

families.name: Ornith
families.scope: Ornith coding models; sizes and quantizations do not change the generation.

families.name: SmolLM
families.scope: SmolLM and SmolVLM, including their numbered language and vision-language releases.

families.name: Bonsai / Ternary
families.scope: Binary and Ternary Bonsai language models. Bit depths and parameter counts are not version numbers; image generators are excluded.

families.name: Dolphin
families.scope: Numbered Dolphin releases and named variants from dphn. The base model version is not the Dolphin version.

families.name: Character.AI
families.scope: Character.AI language models and chat styles, including PipSqueak. Unverified historical c.ai labels await dated publisher evidence.

families.name: Apple Foundation Models
families.scope: Apple Foundation Models, using Apple’s stated generation number. Operating-system versions and parameter counts are excluded.
